# PDF.js 6.5.438

Legacy browser builds and decoding resources copied without library edits from the exact npm dev dependency pdfjs-dist@6.5.438, maintained at https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js. The Apache-2.0 license and resource licenses are included. Reproduce with node scripts/vendor-pdfjs.mjs after npm ci.

The renderer and decoding resources are served from this repository. Only protected bytes are passed to the renderer; no PDF file is sent to an external viewer. No scripting sandbox or PDF action handlers are enabled.
